description: This file defines a Go struct 'FileKeySelectorApplyConfiguration' used for declarative configuration of the 'FileKeySelector' type in Kubernetes client-go. It includes methods for building configuration objects with chainable 'With' functions, and is part of the 'v1' package related to core apply configurations for Kubernetes.
